Floating humanoid, windmilling arms

Ten rigid bodies on R³ × SO(3)¹⁰ (33 DOF): pelvis, torso, upper arms, forearms, thighs and shanks, joined by ball joints. Zero gravity; PD joint moments windmill the arms. The joint moments are internal, so the total momentum stays zero and the whole body pitches in response. Prototype built with geomech; not part of geomech.systems.
